children: Trent Limited (NSE:TRENT) delivered robust growth—Q2 standalone revenue up 23% and H1 up 21% with store expansion (Zudio 1,000 outlets; total 1,342) and a near‑double‑digit stock jump—while analysts at Goldman and Elara turn more positive as Trent raises stake in Satiya/PLIX and margin outlook improves.
: Trent (TRENT) Q2 standalone revenue Rs 5,788 crore (+23% YoY); H1 Rs 11,454 crore (+21% YoY). Added 10 Westside, 17 Zudio stores; Zudio hit 1,000 outlets. Total 1,342 stores. Stock jumped ~10–13%.
: Goldman Sachs raised Trent Limited (TRENT) target to ₹3,010. Analysts note strong performance momentum and forecast continued growth, with majority rating TRENT a buy.
Trent Increases Stake In Satiya Nutraceuticals
: Trent Limited (TRENT) increased its stake in Satiya Nutraceuticals, the parent company of PLIX, by 24.09% for Rs. 1,012.03 crore, taking its total holding to 84.09% on a fully diluted basis.
: Elara Capital analyst Karan Taurani is positive on Trent Limited (TRENT) for the medium term, citing easing fast‑fashion competition and expected margin improvement as raw material inflation cools.
